purpose: Verify Super Admin can create a new hostel record
preconditions: Authenticated as Super Admin; no existing hostel with the same code
expected_result: 201 Created and hostel record persisted

purpose: Verify Super Admin can activate a hostel
preconditions: Authenticated as Super Admin; existing inactive hostel
action_or_input: PATCH /api/v1/hm/hostels/{id} setting active flag to true
expected_result: 200 OK and hostel becomes active

purpose: Create a Warden role binding for a hostel
preconditions: Authenticated as Super Admin; existing hostel; user_id of caretaker exists
expected_result: 201 Created and binding stored with active status

purpose: Create a Caretaker role binding for a hostel
preconditions: Authenticated as Super Admin; existing hostel; user_id of caretaker exists
expected_result: 201 Created and binding stored with active status

purpose: Student submits an accommodation request
preconditions: Authenticated as Student; student has no active request for the hostel
expected_result: 201 Created and request status = Submitted

purpose: Super Admin records initial room allotment
preconditions: Authenticated as Super Admin; existing accommodation request in Submitted state; target room has capacity
expected_result: 200 OK, request status = Allotted, room occupancy incremented

purpose: Super Admin records a central re-allotment or formal vacation update
preconditions: Authenticated as Super Admin; existing room assignment eligible for change
expected_result: 200 OK, assignment status updated, occupancy adjusted accordingly

purpose: Student views own room allocation information
preconditions: Authenticated as Student; student has at least one assignment
expected_result: 200 OK with list of current and historical assignments

purpose: Caretaker updates room availability and occupancy
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker assigned to the hostel; room exists
action_or_input: PATCH /api/v1/hm/rooms/{id} with updated capacity or status
expected_result: 200 OK and room data persisted; occupancy derived automatically

purpose: Caretaker records an individual room exchange
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; two students have assignable rooms; both rooms have capacity for exchange
expected_result: 200 OK, assignments swapped, occupancy remains within limits

purpose: Warden reviews room assignments and occupancy
preconditions: Authenticated as Warden assigned to the hostel
expected_result: 200 OK with assignment list and occupancy stats

purpose: Caretaker records a student attendance entry
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; student belongs to the hostel; valid attendance timestamp
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hm/attendance with student_id and attendance value
expected_result: 201 Created and attendance record stored

purpose: Student views own attendance record
preconditions: Authenticated as Student; attendance records exist for the student
expected_result: 200 OK with list of attendance entries

purpose: Student submits a leave request
preconditions: Authenticated as Student; no active leave request
expected_result: 201 Created and request status = Submitted

purpose: Caretaker approves a leave request
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; leave request in Submitted state
expected_result: 200 OK, request status = Approved, student notified

purpose: Caretaker rejects a leave request
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; leave request in Submitted state
expected_result: 200 OK, request status = Rejected, student notified

purpose: Student views own leave status and history
preconditions: Authenticated as Student; at least one leave request exists
expected_result: 200 OK with list of leave requests and their statuses

purpose: Student submits a hostel-related complaint
preconditions: Authenticated as Student
expected_result: 201 Created and complaint status = Submitted

purpose: Caretaker resolves a complaint without escalation
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; complaint in Submitted state
expected_result: 200 OK, complaint status = Resolved

purpose: Caretaker updates a complaint without resolution
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; complaint in Submitted state
expected_result: 200 OK, complaint status = Updated (Unresolved)

purpose: Caretaker escalates a complaint to a Warden
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; complaint in Submitted or Updated state; escalation supported
expected_result: 200 OK, complaint status = Escalated, visible to Warden

purpose: Warden monitors complaint status and history
preconditions: Authenticated as Warden assigned to the hostel
expected_result: 200 OK with list of complaints and their current states

purpose: Student submits a guest-room booking request
preconditions: Authenticated as Student; no active guest-room request
expected_result: 201 Created and request status = Submitted

purpose: Caretaker approves a guest-room booking request
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; booking request in Submitted state; room available
expected_result: 200 OK, booking status = Approved

purpose: Caretaker rejects a guest-room booking request
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; booking request in Submitted state
expected_result: 200 OK, booking status = Rejected

purpose: Student views own guest-room booking status
preconditions: Authenticated as Student; at least one booking exists
expected_result: 200 OK with list of bookings and their statuses

purpose: Student submits an extended-stay request
preconditions: Authenticated as Student; no active extended-stay request
expected_result: 201 Created and request status = Submitted

purpose: Warden approves an extended-stay request
preconditions: Authenticated as Warden; extended-stay request in Submitted state
expected_result: 200 OK, request status = Approved

purpose: Warden rejects an extended-stay request
preconditions: Authenticated as Warden; extended-stay request in Submitted state
expected_result: 200 OK, request status = Rejected

purpose: Caretaker records a hostel fine
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; student_id valid
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hm/fines with reason, amount, date, student_id
expected_result: 201 Created and fine record stored

purpose: Student views own fine records
preconditions: Authenticated as Student; fine records exist
expected_result: 200 OK with list of fine records

purpose: Caretaker adds an operational inventory item
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; hostel context established
expected_result: 201 Created and inventory item persisted

purpose: Warden creates a guard shift schedule
preconditions: Authenticated as Warden; valid shift dates/times
expected_result: 201 Created and shift record stored

purpose: Caretaker publishes a hostel notice
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; hostel assignment valid
expected_result: 201 Created and notice draft saved

purpose: Publish a drafted hostel notice
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; notice in draft state
expected_result: 200 OK, notice status = Published and visible to audience

purpose: Student views published hostel notices
preconditions: Authenticated as Student; at least one published notice exists for the hostel
expected_result: 200 OK with list of visible notices

purpose: Generate an occupancy report
preconditions: Authenticated as Super Admin or authorized role; report code for occupancy exists
expected_result: 200 OK with aggregated occupancy data

purpose: Warden reviews attendance summary
preconditions: Authenticated as Warden; attendance records exist for the hostel
expected_result: 200 OK with attendance trends and exceptions

purpose: Warden reviews leave information summary
preconditions: Authenticated as Warden; leave records exist for the hostel
expected_result: 200 OK with leave statistics

purpose: Warden reviews fine summary
preconditions: Authenticated as Warden; fine records exist for the hostel
expected_result: 200 OK with disciplinary fine aggregates

purpose: Warden views staff coordination records
preconditions: Authenticated as Warden; staff coordination entries exist
expected_result: 200 OK with list of staff coordination records scoped to the hostel

purpose: Ensure a Student cannot create a hostel
preconditions: Authenticated as Student
expected_result: 403 Forbidden due to missing hm.hostel.create permission

purpose: Prevent a Caretaker from submitting an accommodation request
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker
expected_result: 403 Forbidden because only hm.accommodation_request.create is granted to Students

purpose: Reject room update that would reduce capacity below current occupancy
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; room has occupancy = 3; current capacity = 5
expected_result: 400 Bad Request with error about capacity constraint (BR-HM-010)

purpose: Reject initial allotment when target room is at full capacity
preconditions: Authenticated as Super Admin; target room occupancy = capacity
expected_result: 400 Bad Request indicating room capacity violation

purpose: Ensure a Student cannot approve a guest-room booking
preconditions: Authenticated as Student
expected_result: 403 Forbidden because hm.guest_booking.approve is not granted to Students

purpose: Prevent a Student from deciding on an extended-stay request
preconditions: Authenticated as Student
expected_result: 403 Forbidden; only hm.extended_stay_request.approve granted to Wardens

purpose: Confirm /api/v1/hm/notifications is inaccessible
preconditions: Authenticated as any role
expected_result: 404 Not Found or 403 Forbidden as the endpoint is blocked
